name: capnp-ls-client
description: A language client of Cap'n Proto Language Server
author: Atsushi Tomida

capnp-ls-client.languageServer.path.description: Explicit path to the Cap'n Proto language server executable

capnp-ls-client.languageServer.version.description: capnp-ls release tag used for automatic Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 downloads

capnp-ls-client.languageServer.capnpVers.description: Cap'n Proto compiler version linked into the automatically downloaded language server binary

capnp-ls-client.compiler.importPaths.description: Additional import paths for Cap'n Proto schemas

capnp-ls-client.server.extraEnv.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables that will be passed to the capnp-ls executable. Useful for passing e.g. `CPP_LOG=lsp_server=info` for debugging.
